Game results and scores

compute_game_results.Rd

Turn the saved game list into one row per team game with a running record, and the scores table into one row per team per game.

Usage

compute_game_results(game_results_raw)

tidy_scores(scores)

add_game_scores(game_results, scores_tidy)

Arguments

game_results_raw

One row per team game: dateGame, numberGameTeamSeason, nameTeam, slugMatchup, slugTeam, slugTeamLoser.

scores

One row per game: game_id, game_date, away_team, home_team, slug_away_team, slug_home_team, away_score, home_score.

game_results

The result of compute_game_results().

scores_tidy

The result of tidy_scores().

Value

compute_game_results() returns a grouped tibble with current_wins, current_losses, and current_win_perc (a percentage from 0 to 100) per team, "LA " spelled out as "Los Angeles ", sorted by team. tidy_scores() returns one row per team per game with team_slug, opponent_slug, score, and opponent_score. add_game_scores() adds each game's score, record, and a readable result text to game_results.

Examples

gr <- compute_game_results(pool_example$game_results_raw)
st <- tidy_scores(pool_example$scores)
add_game_scores(gr, st)
#> # A tibble: 4 × 19
#> # Groups:   Team Name [3]
#>   slugSeason `Game Date` game_id `Game Number` `Team Name`  slugMatchup slugTeam
#>   <chr>      <date>      <chr>           <int> <chr>        <chr>       <chr>   
#> 1 2026-27    2026-10-20  g1                  1 Alpha        ALP vs. BRA ALP     
#> 2 2026-27    2026-10-21  g2                  2 Alpha        ALP @ CLI   ALP     
#> 3 2026-27    2026-10-20  g1                  1 Bravo        BRA @ ALP   BRA     
#> 4 2026-27    2026-10-21  g2                  1 Los Angeles… CLI vs. ALP CLI     
#> # ℹ 12 more variables: slugOpponent <chr>, slugTeamLoser <chr>, win <dbl>,
#> #   loss <dbl>, current_wins <dbl>, current_losses <dbl>,
#> #   current_win_perc <dbl>, score <dbl>, opponent_score <dbl>,
#> #   final_score <chr>, `Current Record` <chr>, `Game Result` <chr>
